title: File:Barclay's Iron Eagle (5172412806).jpg
art: Andrew Smith from Seattle, WA, USA
desc:
The 'Iron' Eagle of Barclay's Bank on a wall of black marble.
The eagle logo dates back to 1690 when John Freame and Thomas Gould started trading as goldsmith bankers in Lombard Street, London. The bank later became known as Barclays.
